name: Sumire
source:
The oldest most experienced maid of Kouga Genzou's mansion.
Sumire is the mansion a living encyclopedia and her special ability is walking down the corridor without making any sound. She has a scary face that can really startle anyone when they meet her in the dark.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=933594&gc=gc]Getchu[/url].]
